title: Add P2-007 validator to final-head CI
businessObjective: Ensure each P2-007 merge candidate executes its static resource-budget validator in final-head CI without granting CI or the contract resource authority.
technicalObjective: Add one fixed GitHub Actions step for the already admitted P2-007 validator and document bounded final-head assurance; do not change P2-007 product artifacts or add generic command execution.
assumptions: GOV-054 admits the exact literal node tests/resource-governance/validate-resource-budget-contract-v1.mjs with shell:false fixed arguments.
P2-007 is independently verified but remains verified until this final-head CI assurance is merged and PR #119 is rebased and rechecked.
No resource meter, quota action, provider, queue, workflow, scheduler, notifier, booking capacity, external service, or production operation is authorized.
acceptanceCriteria: The Governance / validate workflow invokes exactly node tests/resource-governance/validate-resource-budget-contract-v1.mjs as a distinct fixed step after repository fast verification.
No generic or dynamic command, shell execution, interpolated path/arguments, matrix, credential, external service, deployment, or P2-007 product change is added.

Verification policy and a durable risk entry state that the fixed final-head step proves only the static P2-007 merge candidate and creates no resource-control, scheduling, execution, notification, booking, or production capability.
Packet checks, independent Sol review, task-specific machine evidence, and final-head CI explicitly show the P2-007 validator ran and passed.
allowedCommands: npm run verify:task -- --task SUT-AIOS-GOV-055 --verifier-agent qa-verification --verifier-model gpt-5.6-sol --acceptance-confirmed
requiredChecks: machine evidence explicitly recording P2-007 validator execution
solEscalationTriggers: Any generic or dynamic CI execution, shell invocation, credential, external service, deployment, resource-control behavior, or P2-007 product change requires a separate approved packet.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only the fixed P2-007 CI step, policy statement, GOV-055 packet/evidence/risk entry, and lifecycle record; preserve P2-007 implementation/evidence, GOV-054 history, terminal records, canonical sources, immutable snapshots, and external systems.
